L_sys.name: system grammar
L_sys.purpose: Represent recurrent structural roles of the modeled cognitive system without requiring a complete scientific assertion language.

L_claim.name: scientific claim / assertion layer
L_claim.purpose: Represent semantics of what a scientific claim asserts about system/context objects and relations, including semantics not reducible to system roles.
L_claim.source_of_need: Residual adjudication: 4/17 residual claims have primary RELATION_LANGUAGE_GAP; additional relation-language pressures also occur in PARTIAL lanes.

L_ctx.name: source context / experimental parameter layer
L_ctx.purpose: Represent source-defined conditions, regimes, indices and parameters required to state a claim but not licensed as Pi/X/C/Q/P/K/T/rho system roles.
retained_examples: phase / condition identity beyond temporal order
L_ctx.source_of_need: Residual adjudication: 13/17 residual claims have primary SOURCE_CONTEXT_PARAMETER.
L_ctx.guardrail: A node is not C merely because it is called a condition; C requires frozen realizability/admissibility support.

L_formal.name: formal carrier / realization layer
L_formal.purpose: Provide one typed mathematical realization of L_sys and explicit forgetful/comparator views without making implementation signatures source evidence.
known_pressure: Discussion-level K permits broader typed dependence than the current Pin-indexed transition signature.
Frozen O may occur without P_out and may participate in O->X or O->O relations.
Indexed Config fibers require explicit carry/transport for persistence.
L_formal.guardrail: A formal-carrier mismatch is not a ROLE_GAP.

dependencies.meaning: Claims may assert relations among system-role instances.
Claims may be indexed by source-defined contexts or experimental conditions.
Formal structures implement a typed carrier for the system grammar.
A richer formal assertion language may encode claim semantics, but the current Grammar record does not claim to do so.
Context may select or parameterize a system instance without becoming a system role.

forbidden_conflations: SOURCE_CONTEXT_PARAMETER -> C solely from the word 'condition'
RELATION_LANGUAGE_GAP -> K solely because it is a relation
epistemic O->X inference -> forward rho without an explicit estimator layer
formal signature plumbing -> source-supported scientific role
persistence -> literal K = identity without typed carry/transport

derived_structure_policy.rule: Treat as structure derived over L_sys/L_ctx when a frozen witness supports the derivation; otherwise retain as DERIVED_STRUCTURE_GAP rather than promoting a primitive.

manuscript_safe_claims: Grammar v0 is a recurrent system-role grammar recovered from the bounded frozen corpus.
Grammar v0 is not a complete scientific claim language.
Residuals principally motivate separate claim, context and formal-carrier layers rather than a ninth system role.
The layered architecture is a presentation and validation separation, not a new ontology.
prohibited_claims: The nine roles are ontological primitives of cognition.
All cognition must instantiate all nine roles.
The Lean Grammar record is the unique mathematical realization.
No weaker formalism can encode the corpus under any re-encoding.
